title: PARI unequal-bound honesty cut
objective: Implement and differentially verify the smallest faithful PARI 2.17.4 unequal-bound be_honest cut, preserving decision, RNG, and retry observables; otherwise record an exact blocking dependency map

handoff.summary: Pinned a real PARI 2.17.4 be_honest unequal-bound failure fixture (C1=5, C2=31) and implemented the reusable positive-prime-power retry-ideal and random_bits(4) cut as ordinary Python with exact CPython, JavaScript, GMP-native, and tagged-native replay. The checker rebuilds an instrumented pristine source and authenticates 51 no-cache probes, 50 random retries, every exponent, every determinant norm, the full ideal-HNF transcript, final KCZ, and RNG state. Full pnpm test:native, pnpm test:baselib:strict, pnpm build:check, and focused tests pass.
risks: This deliberately bounded cut does not yet implement the scheduler around bnf_build_nofb; it must not replace the current -206 frontier.
The fixture exercises the actual unequal-bound retry path ending in failure, not the rarer success path that increments KCZ and restores the accepted relation state.
